limitations: Catalog is not an exhaustive inventory of all possible strategies.
Most daily scan snapshots cover only 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-05; older historical markers contain first events, not full daily scans.
Signal studies are overlapping event returns, not account compound returns.
POC paired comparison covers known-profile candidates, largely 2026; no independent out-of-sample validation.
Frozen account range prices are execution assumptions, not verified fills.
Original replay is a fixed earlier account, not an arbitrary portfolio of all 29 entry rules.
Local sealed .cache source files are required; unavailable sources raise explicit errors.
